title: Films, documentation and needing an agent
summary: He would do films if someone fronted, mentioning Willard Alexander.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Now, in terms of other things that you would like to leave. When I say leave, I mean documentations of your talents and your creative abilities. You had mentioned before that things like movies that, you know, that Harry James and some of the other band
leaders were getting that you didn't get at that time. Would you still be interested in things like that?
Sure. I wouldn't turn them down cause long as I'm in the business, you know, it's still good.
But, would you acticely go after them?

Well, I've been approached up have a couple of times. But, you know, it wasn't nothing real solid. But, I'll say, if it happened, I would do it. I would do it. I wouldn't actually go after it now unless I'd find someone to front me. You see?
Then, if it was a possibility, I would. Cause, I've nothing against it. That's what it takes to make them all. If I had the opportunity to make them all.
It's never too late, I don't think.
When you say someone to front me, what would that entail?

I was talking about an agent, someone to go up and take care of that business properly cause I wouldn't be able to do it, like I'm here. And then, they'd know which doors to knock on where I wouldn't know which door to knock cause I haven't been in. I've always had someone fronting for me.
And, I think it would be a better deal, and quicker cause it can be a little rough for you if you do it yourself. Personally.

Yeah. Well, you're one of those fortunate individuals that managed to have a manager, you know, for a long period of time that you were satisfied with, and that you felt was capable of looking out for your interest and his interest. So, I can see why you might, you know, find that to be a good working kind of relationship. Do you think that there are many of those kinds of managers or

I wouldn't know. But, I suppose it is. You know, like Count Basie now. Willard Alexander? Whoever it is, That's a good relation. It keeps him, you know. Willard Alexander (Inaudible) called me once when I was up here to go out and do a date for him. I did. I took a, I had to make that night off for me. It was somewhere in Pennsylvania. Reading? MR. GOINES: Yes. MR. HAWKINS: I think it was Reading, Pennsylvania. It was a big affair. He said that the people wrote to him for me. Then, he had to look and found out where I was. He forgot, he knew I was up here. So, his office found out where I was. And, I went through his office to go to Reading to do that date for him. 'Cause Willard Alexander, I guess, is one of the big offices around.
